simple.meaning: בֹּרִית (bôrîyth) is a Hebrew word meaning “vegetable alkali.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: בֹּרִית (H1287) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Jeremiah 2:22, with occurrences in Jeremiah, Malachi.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בֹּרִית (H1287) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in בֹּרִית (H1287) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: בֹּרִית (bôrîyth) / H1287 is traced through Jeremiah 2:22, Malachi 3:2 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H1287. borith בֹּרִית noun feminine lye, alkali, potash , soap, used in washing Jer 2:22 ; Mal 3:2 .
